title: Target campaigns: five companies, every channel, on a cadence
purpose: Pick the five companies where hiring, size and fit overlap, then work each one by email with a Loom, LinkedIn and a phone call, with follow-ups on day 3, 7 and 14.
why: Anyone can now say they build with AI, and managers are flooded with it. What they still trust a person with is a high-stakes problem: an agent acting inside real systems, data that has to be right, approvals, reliability, legacy integrations, owning the outcome with a customer. Five companies worked on every channel, each told which of those problems you'd own and why you're trusted with it, beat fifty cold applications.
evidence: Your Hire page's Targets: five companies, every touch logged, replies tracked.

tasks.title: Choose five targets on your Hire page
tasks.done_when: Five companies hiring for your titles, the right size, a strong fit, ideally someone inside, each marked as a target.

tasks.title: Day 0 on each target: email with your Loom, a LinkedIn request, a call
tasks.done_when: Every channel sent on five targets, each logged on Hire.

tasks.title: Follow up on day 3, 7 and 14, one new thing each time
tasks.done_when: No target goes silent before day 14 without a follow-up.
